subject: Hyperspring: request for tenant-specific log retention carveout and evidence coordination
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@hyperspring.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: LegalOps <legal@hyperspring.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant-specific retention carveout request — Hyperspring

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the platform looked great. As we discussed, Hyperspring needs a narrow retention carveout for one of our production tenants while we run an extended debugging program. Specifically: we need request/response debug traces and inference session logs retained for 120 days (instead of Redwood's default 30 days) for tenant ID hspr-prod-7.

We're preparing a SOC 2 oversight package and our compliance team asked for:
- A short description of Redwood's policy for customer-specific retention exceptions (who approves, where documented).
- Evidence that logs for the tenant are (a) isolated, (b) retained for the requested window, and (c) deletable on demand after the window — e.g., proof-of-delete manifests or API audit records.
- Any relevant SIG/CAIQ artifacts that reference log retention and erase workflows.

I've attached a one-page request and our compliance contact (LegalOps) is on cc. Can you confirm the process & timeline? We need a response to our SOC auditor in ~10 business days.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Platform
Hyperspring AI
attachments: hyperspring-retention-request.pdf (pdf)
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: alex.chen@hyperspring.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant-specific retention carveout request — Hyperspring

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. Quick confirmation: Redwood does support customer-scoped retention variances for production tenants in cases like extended debugging, subject to legal review and operational controls.

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll route this to our Security/Compliance track and loop in Karthik (sec) + Monica (ops) to scope the technical isolation and proof artifacts.
2) Karthik will propose the evidence packet (SOC2-friendly) and expected delivery date — aim: 7 business days.
3) We typically require a signed amendment or an email acceptance from your LegalOps confirming the tenant and retention window before changes are applied. Monica will propose the API/manifest format for proof-of-delete.

Cc'd: Karthik, Monica — can you confirm you can pick this up and whether you need anything else from Hyperspring? Alex — if you can share a brief contractual reference (SOW or purchase order) or a redline request, that speeds legal.

Best,
Sofia
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: alex.chen@hyperspring.ai, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant-specific retention carveout request — Hyperspring

Alex / Sofia — picking this up from security side. Summary of what we'll provide and proposed timeline:

What we'll deliver (target delivery: 5 business days from now):
- Process doc excerpt: internal approval flow, roles (Security, Legal, Ops), and where tenant carveouts are recorded.
- Isolation description: architecture note showing tenant-scoped storage buckets/indices and access controls.
- Evidence bundle: (a) time-stamped retention configuration export for tenant hspr-prod-7, (b) sample proof-of-delete manifest format (SHA256 hashes + timestamps + operator id), and (c) a 7-day rolling audit excerpt showing deletion API calls.
- SIG/CAIQ pointers: exported CAIQ answers referencing data lifecycle questions and any supporting artifacts (if needed we can extract specific fields).

What we need from Hyperspring to proceed:
1) Written confirmation from your LegalOps to proceed with the exception for tenant hspr-prod-7 and acceptance of the retention window (120 days) and associated controls (please reply-to-all).
2) Any contract reference or PO number you want recorded in the amendment.

Attachments I'm sending now (internal templates): redline-template.docx, evidence-checklist.csv. Those are the formats we'll use in the evidence packet. Monica: ops will schedule the config change after we receive LegalOps confirmation and sign-off; we will not apply changes retroactively without explicit approval.

K
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

LegalOps confirms in-line: Hyperspring LegalOps authorizes Redwood to apply a tenant-level retention policy of 120 days for tenant hspr-prod-7 and agrees to execute a short amendment that references PO# 54721.
